description: Log and query agent actions / outcomes (tweets sent, deploys triggered, CI runs, shell commands). First-class execution telemetry — distinct from activity_log which captures PM mutations. Methods: log (record an action), list (filter by channel/agent/status/time), get (single by id), update_metrics (patch metrics_json after-the-fact, e.g. tweet engagement 24h later)

action_type.description: Action like published | sent | triggered | completed | failed (required for: log)

channel.description: Channel like twitter | linkedin | email | postiz | ci | deploy | shell (required for: log)

content_ref.description: What was acted on (free text, e.g. 'Show HN draft v3') (for: log)

entity_refs.description: Source entity links: {story_id?, feature_id?, decision_id?, note_id?} (for: log)

external_link.description: URL of the published artifact (for: log)

metrics_json.description: Metrics object (engagement, exit_code, duration_ms, ...) (for: log, update_metrics)

occurred_at.description: Unix ms timestamp when the action happened (default: now) (for: log)

project_id.description: Project ID (for: log, list — auto-detected if omitted)

since.description: Unix ms — return executions occurring after (for: list)

until.description: Unix ms — return executions occurring before (for: list)

name: executions
